/-- Left inverse `nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 base ∘ fin2OfNonFixedNucleus = id` (zero axioms). -/

/-- Right inverse `fin2OfNonFixedNucleus ∘ nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 base = id` (zero axioms). -/
theorem nonFixedNucleus_right_inv (base : FixedNucleus) (j : Fin 2) :
    fin2OfNonFixedNucleus (nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 base j) = j := by
  rcases base with ⟨⟨ba, bb, bc⟩, _, ⟨bheb, _, _⟩⟩
  rcases j with ⟨_ | _ | n, hn⟩

    · rfl

/-- Recursive constructive fiber tuple of `NonFixedNucleus` assignments over attached fixed-point targets. -/
def NonFixedTuple : ∀ {m : Nat}, Tuple FixedNucleus m → Type
  | 0, _ => PUnit
  | _ + 1, (b, bs) => NonFixedNucleus b × NonFixedTuple bs

private def fixedTupleToFin3 : ∀ {k : Nat}, Tuple FixedNucleus k → Tuple (Fin 3) k
  | 0, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (x, tl) => (fin3OfFixedNucleus x, fixedTupleToFin3 tl)

private def fin3TupleToFixed : ∀ {k : Nat}, Tuple (Fin 3) k → Tuple FixedNucleus k
  | 0, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (i, tl) => (fixedNucleusOfFin3 i, fin3TupleToFixed tl)

private theorem fixedTuple_left_inv : ∀ {k : Nat} (xs : Tuple FixedNucleus k),
    fin3TupleToFixed (fixedTupleToFin3 xs) = xs
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, (x, tl) => by
    change (fixedNucleusOfFin3 (fin3OfFixedNucleus x), fin3TupleToFixed (fixedTupleToFin3 tl)) = (x, tl)
    rw [fixedNucleus_left_inv x, fixedTuple_left_inv tl]

private theorem fixedTuple_right_inv : ∀ {k : Nat} (is : Tuple (Fin 3) k),
    fixedTupleToFin3 (fin3TupleToFixed is) = is
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, (i, tl) => by
    change (fin3OfFixedNucleus (fixedNucleusOfFin3 i), fixedTupleToFin3 (fin3TupleToFixed tl)) = (i, tl)
    rw [fixedNucleus_right_inv i, fixedTuple_right_inv tl]

private def nonFixedTupleToFin2 : ∀ {m : Nat} {bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m},
    NonFixedTuple bases → Tuple (Fin 2) m
  | 0, _, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (_, _), (x, tl) => (fin2OfNonFixedNucleus x, nonFixedTupleToFin2 tl)

private def fin2TupleToNonFixed : ∀ {m : Nat} (bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m),
    Tuple (Fin 2) m → NonFixedTuple bases
  | 0, _, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (b, bs), (j, tl) => (nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 b j, fin2TupleToNonFixed bs tl)

private theorem nonFixedTuple_left_inv : ∀ {m : Nat} {bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m}
    (xs : NonFixedTuple bases), fin2TupleToNonFixed bases (nonFixedTupleToFin2 xs) = xs
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, (b, bs), (x, tl) => by
    change (nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 b (fin2OfNonFixedNucleus x), fin2TupleToNonFixed bs (nonFixedTupleToFin2 tl)) = (x, tl)
    rw [nonFixedNucleus_left_inv b x, nonFixedTuple_left_inv tl]

private theorem nonFixedTuple_right_inv : ∀ {m : Nat} (bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m)
    (js : Tuple (Fin 2) m), nonFixedTupleToFin2 (fin2TupleToNonFixed bases js) = js
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, (b, bs), (j, tl) => by
    change (fin2OfNonFixedNucleus (nonFixedNucleusOfFin2 b j), nonFixedTupleToFin2 (fin2TupleToNonFixed bs tl)) = (j, tl)
    rw [nonFixedNucleus_right_inv b j, nonFixedTuple_right_inv bs tl]

/-- Constructive projection of `(k, m)` slice nuclei onto `Tuple (Fin 3) k × Tuple (Fin 2) m`. -/
def sliceNucleusToProd {k m : Nat} {bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m}
    (p : Tuple FixedNucleus k × NonFixedTuple bases) : Tuple (Fin 3) k × Tuple (Fin 2) m :=
  (fixedTupleToFin3 p.1, nonFixedTupleToFin2 p.2)

/-- Constructive reconstruction of `(k, m)` slice nuclei from `Tuple (Fin 3) k × Tuple (Fin 2) m`. -/
def sliceNucleusOfProd {k m : Nat} (bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m)
    (q : Tuple (Fin 3) k × Tuple (Fin 2) m) : Tuple FixedNucleus k × NonFixedTuple bases :=
  (fin3TupleToFixed q.1, fin2TupleToNonFixed bases q.2)

/-- Left inverse certifying `(k, m)` nucleus bijection onto `(Fin 3)^k × (Fin 2)^m` (zero axioms). -/
theorem sliceNucleus_left_inv {k m : Nat} (bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m)
    (p : Tuple FixedNucleus k × NonFixedTuple bases) :
    sliceNucleusOfProd bases (sliceNucleusToProd p) = p := by
  cases p with | mk pf pn =>
  dsimp only [sliceNucleusToProd, sliceNucleusOfProd]
  rw [fixedTuple_left_inv pf, nonFixedTuple_left_inv pn]

/-- Right inverse certifying `(k, m)` nucleus bijection onto `(Fin 3)^k × (Fin 2)^m` (zero axioms). -/
theorem sliceNucleus_right_inv {k m : Nat} (bases : Tuple FixedNucleus m)
    (q : Tuple (Fin 3) k × Tuple (Fin 2) m) :
    sliceNucleusToProd (sliceNucleusOfProd bases q) = q := by
  cases q with | mk qf qn =>
  dsimp only [sliceNucleusToProd, sliceNucleusOfProd]
  rw [fixedTuple_right_inv qf, nonFixedTuple_right_inv bases qn]

private theorem nat_mul_assoc_zero (a b c : Nat) : (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) := by
  induction c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    change (a * b) * k + a * b = a * (b * k + b)
    rw [ih, Nat.left_distrib]

private theorem nat_add_mul_zero (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c := by
  induction c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    change (a + b) * k + (a + b) = (a * k + a) + (b * k + b)
    rw [ih, Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_assoc (b * k) a b, Nat.add_comm (b * k) a,
        Nat.add_assoc a (b * k) b, ← Nat.add_assoc]

private theorem nat_pow_add_zero (a k m : Nat) : a ^ (k + m) = a ^ k * a ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact (Nat.mul_one _).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    change a ^ (k + n) * a = a ^ k * (a ^ n * a)
    rw [ih, nat_mul_assoc_zero]

private theorem nat_succ_sub_succ_zero (m k : Nat) : (m + 1) - (k + 1) = m - k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => exact congrArg Nat.pred ih

private theorem nat_add_sub_of_le_zero {a b : Nat} : a ≤ b → a + (b - a) = b := by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
    have hs : ∀ n : Nat, n - n = 0 := fun n ↦ by
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ihk => rw [nat_succ_sub_succ_zero k k, ihk]
    rw [hs a, Nat.add_zero]
  | @step m hm ih =>
    have hsucc : ∀ x y : Nat, x ≤ y → (y + 1) - x = (y - x) + 1 := by
      intro x y hxy
      induction y generalizing x with
      | zero =>
        cases x with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ z => exact False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_zero z hxy)
      | succ u ihu =>
        cases x with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ z =>
          rw [nat_succ_sub_succ_zero (u + 1) z, nat_succ_sub_succ_zero u z]
          exact ihu z (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hxy)
    rw [hsucc a m hm, Nat.add_succ, ih]

private theorem pow2_le_pow3_zero : ∀ k : Nat, 2 ^ k ≤ 3 ^ k
  | 0 => Nat.le_refl 1
  | k + 1 =>
    Nat.le_trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 (pow2_le_pow3_zero k))
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 ^ k) (Nat.le_succ 2))

/-- Flow F3 arithmetic partition `3^k * 2^m = 2^(k + m) + (3^k - 2^k) * 2^m` (zero axioms). -/
theorem flow_f3_card_partition (k m : Nat) :
    3 ^ k * 2 ^ m = 2 ^ (k + m) + (3 ^ k - 2 ^ k) * 2 ^ m := by
  rw [nat_pow_add_zero, ← nat_add_mul_zero, nat_add_sub_of_le_zero (pow2_le_pow3_zero k)]

/-- Finite 5-element Lawvere–Tierney lattice modeling a Guardrail-3 Muchnik Pareto Schism `{j1, j2}`. -/
inductive SchismLTT : Type
  | idBot   -- id_Ω
  | meetMid -- j_{O1} ∧ j_{O2} > id_Ω
  | j1      -- j_{O1}
  | j2      -- j_{O2}
  | topDeg  -- degenerate ⊤
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Exact Boolean equality on `SchismLTT` without wildcards (zero axioms). -/
def SchismLTT.eqBool : SchismLTT → SchismLTT → Bool
  | .idBot, .idBot => true | .idBot, .meetMid => false | .idBot, .j1 => false | .idBot, .j2 => false | .idBot, .topDeg => false
  | .meetMid, .idBot => false | .meetMid, .meetMid => true | .meetMid, .j1 => false | .meetMid, .j2 => false | .meetMid, .topDeg => false
  | .j1, .idBot => false | .j1, .meetMid => false | .j1, .j1 => true | .j1, .j2 => false | .j1, .topDeg => false
  | .j2, .idBot => false | .j2, .meetMid => false | .j2, .j1 => false | .j2, .j2 => true | .j2, .topDeg => false
  | .topDeg, .idBot => false | .topDeg, .meetMid => false | .topDeg, .j1 => false | .topDeg, .j2 => false | .topDeg, .topDeg => true

private theorem schism_eqBool_self : ∀ x : SchismLTT, SchismLTT.eqBool x x = true
  | .idBot => rfl | .meetMid => rfl | .j1 => rfl | .j2 => rfl | .topDeg => rfl

private theorem schism_absurd {a b : SchismLTT} (hf : SchismLTT.eqBool a b = false) (h : a = b) : False := by
  cases h
  exact Bool.noConfusion ((schism_eqBool_self a).symm.trans hf)

/-- Pointwise order `≤` on `SchismLTT` without wildcards (zero axioms). -/
def SchismLTT.le : SchismLTT → SchismLTT → Bool
  | .idBot, .idBot => true | .idBot, .meetMid => true | .idBot, .j1 => true | .idBot, .j2 => true | .idBot, .topDeg => true
  | .meetMid, .idBot => false | .meetMid, .meetMid => true | .meetMid, .j1 => true | .meetMid, .j2 => true | .meetMid, .topDeg => true

  | .j2, .idBot => false | .j2, .meetMid => false | .j2, .j1 => false | .j2, .j2 => true | .j2, .topDeg => true

/-- Doctrinal domain `(D, mul, zero, boxSigma)` with Alexandrov S4 interior operator. -/
structure DoctrinalDomain (D : Type) where

  mul : D → D → D
  /-- Terminal / trivial doctrine `0` (`1`). -/

  /-- Modal S4 stability interior `Box_Σ : Set D → Set D`. -/

  box_mono : ∀ {U V : Set D}, (∀ d, U d → V d) → ∀ d, boxSigma U d → boxSigma V d
  /-- S4 Axiom 4 (idempotence): `Box_Σ(U) ⊆ Box_Σ(Box_Σ(U))`. -/
  box_idem : ∀ U d, boxSigma U d → boxSigma (boxSigma U) d

  box_sInter : ∀ (F : Set (Set D)) (d : D),

/-- Off-core locus `(D \ H) ∪ K`. -/

def IsModalExact {D : Type} (dom : DoctrinalDomain D) (E : Set D) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, dom.boxSigma E d ↔ E d

def mooreClosureOf {D : Type} (M : Set (Set D)) (U : Set D) : Set D :=
  fun d ↦ ∀ E, (M E ∧ ∀ x, U x → E x) → E d

def ZeroGiraudP0 {D : Type} (M : Set (Set D)) (K T : Set D) : Prop :=

/-- Axiom (P2 — Directed Union Closure): `ℳ` is closed under nonempty directed unions. -/
def ZeroGiraudP2 {D : Type} (M : Set (Set D)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : Set (Set D), (∀ E, c E → M E) → c.Nonempty →
    (∀ E₁, c E₁ → ∀ E₂, c E₂ → ∃ E₃, c E₃ ∧ (∀ d, E₁ d → E₃ d) ∧ (∀ d, E₂ d → E₃ d)) →

    (hP0 : ZeroGiraudP0 M K T) (hP2 : ZeroGiraudP2 M) :
    ∃ R : Set D, mooreClosureOf M K ⊆ R ∧
      IsMaxLivingZone M K T R ∧ Maximal (· ∈ { E : Set D | InLivingZone M K T E }) R := by

  have hChain : ∀ c ⊆ S, IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c → c.Nonempty → ∃ ub ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ c, s ⊆ ub := by
    intro c hcS hcChain ⟨E₀, hE₀⟩

        · exact ⟨E₂, hE₂, fun d hd ↦ h12 hd, fun _ h ↦ h⟩
        · exact ⟨E₁, hE₁, fun _ h ↦ h, fun d hd ↦ h21 hd⟩

  \item \textbf{Zero-Oracle Gauge Cost:} Purely computable symmetry-breaking or orbit-stabilizer accounting (for example, $(R_{2,2}, \phi_{\mathrm{aug}})$ Species enumeration) incurring zero non-computable oracles.
  \item \textbf{Oracle Cost:} Non-computable choice or realizability strength metered by Lawvere--Tierney topologies $j_{\mathcal{O}}$ and extended Weihrauch degrees.

\end{enumerate}
\end{definition}

\begin{inlineclaim}[Game-Comonad Hierarchy, Coalgebra Numbers, and Polyadic Lov\'asz Probes]\label{ch01:claim:abramsky-arboreal-coalgebra-numbers}%

\end{inlineclaim}

/-- Descending resource-indexed equivalence tower `(≡_k)_{k ∈ ℕ}` on a model carrier `M`. -/
structure DescendingResourceTower (M : Type) where
  /-- Level-`k` equivalence relation `x ≡_k y`. -/
  equiv : Nat → M → M → Prop
  /-- Reflexivity at every level `k`. -/
  refl : ∀ k x, equiv k x x
  /-- Symmetry at every level `k`. -/
  symm : ∀ {k x y}, equiv k x y → equiv k y x
  /-- Transitivity at every level `k`. -/
  trans : ∀ {k x y z}, equiv k x y → equiv k y z → equiv k x z
  /-- Antitonicity (descending filtration): `m ≤ k → (≡_k ⊆ ≡_m)`. -/
  anti : ∀ {m k x y}, m ≤ k → equiv k x y → equiv m x y
/-- Asymptotic `k = ∞` equivalence `⋂_{k ∈ ℕ} ≡_k`. -/
def DescendingResourceTower.infEquiv {M : Type} (τ : DescendingResourceTower M)
    (x y : M) : Prop := ∀ k : Nat, τ.equiv k x y
/-- Pullback relation `I*(R)(x, y) := R (I x) (I y)`. -/
def pullbackRel {M₁ M₂ : Type} (I : M₁ → M₂) (R : M₂ → M₂ → Prop)
    (x y : M₁) : Prop := R (I x) (I y)
/-- Two-sided distorted bi-interpretation `(I, J; η)` between descending resource towers. -/
structure DistortedBiInterpretation {M₁ M₂ : Type}
    (τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁) (τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂) where
  /-- Forward model interpretation `I : Mod(T₁) → Mod(T₂)`. -/
  I : M₁ → M₂
  /-- Backward model interpretation `J : Mod(T₂) → Mod(T₁)`. -/
  J : M₂ → M₁
  /-- Forward multiplicative distortion `a ≥ 1`. -/
  a : Nat
  /-- Forward additive distortion `b`. -/
  b : Nat
  /-- Positivity of forward slope `a`. -/
  ha : 0 < a
  /-- Backward multiplicative distortion `a' ≥ 1`. -/
  a' : Nat
  /-- Backward additive distortion `b'`. -/
  b' : Nat
  /-- Positivity of backward slope `a'`. -/
  ha' : 0 < a'
  /-- Forward simulation bound: `x ≡_{a*k+b}^{T₁} y → I x ≡_k^{T₂} I y`. -/
  forward_bound : ∀ k x y, τ₁.equiv (a * k + b) x y → τ₂.equiv k (I x) (I y)
  /-- Backward simulation bound: `u ≡_{a'*m+b'}^{T₂} v → J u ≡_m^{T₁} J v`. -/
  backward_bound : ∀ m u v, τ₂.equiv (a' * m + b') u v → τ₁.equiv m (J u) (J v)
  /-- Unit isomorphism invariance `η_x : x ≅ J (I x)` at every resource level `m`. -/
  unit_equiv : ∀ m x, τ₁.equiv m x (J (I x))
private theorem morita_succ_sub_succ (m k : Nat) : (m + 1) - (k + 1) = m - k := by
  induction k with | zero => rfl | succ _ ih => exact congrArg Nat.pred ih
private theorem morita_sub_le (x y : Nat) : x - y ≤ x := by
  induction y with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl x | succ _ ih => exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.pred_le _) ih
private theorem morita_sub_add_cancel {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) : (b - a) + a = b := by
  induction b generalizing a with
  | zero => cases a with | zero => rfl | succ k => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero k h)
  | succ m ih => cases a with | zero => rfl | succ k =>
    rw [morita_succ_sub_succ m k]
    change (m - k + k) + 1 = m + 1; rw [ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)]
private theorem morita_div_go_mul_le (y : Nat) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ (fuel x : Nat) (hfuel : x < fuel), y * Nat.div.go y hy fuel x hfuel ≤ x
  | 0, _, hfuel => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hfuel)
  | fuel + 1, x, hfuel => by
    rw [Nat.div.go.eq_def]; dsimp only; split
    · next hle =>
      have hlt : x - y < fuel := by
        cases y with | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 hy) | succ y' => cases x with
          | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero y' hle)
          | succ x' =>
            rw [morita_succ_sub_succ]
            exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (morita_sub_le x' y') (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hfuel)
      rw [Nat.mul_succ]
      have h1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (morita_div_go_mul_le y hy fuel (x - y) hlt) y
      rw [morita_sub_add_cancel hle] at h1; exact h1
    · exact Nat.zero_le x
private theorem morita_mul_div_le (a b : Nat) : a * (b / a) ≤ b := by
  change a * Nat.div b a ≤ b; rw [Nat.div.eq_def]; split
  · next ha => exact morita_div_go_mul_le a ha (b + 1) b (Nat.lt_succ_self b)
  · exact Nat.zero_le b
/-- Forward finite-level interleaving: `(≡_{a*k+b}^{T₁}) ⊆ I*(≡_k^{T₂})`. -/
theorem morita_forward_interleaving {M₁ M₂ : Type} {τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁}
    {τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂} (B : DistortedBiInterpretation τ₁ τ₂) (k : Nat) (x y : M₁) :
    τ₁.equiv (B.a * k + B.b) x y → pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv k) x y := B.forward_bound k x y
/-- Backward finite-level interleaving: `I*(≡_{a'*m+b'}^{T₂}) ⊆ (≡_m^{T₁})`. -/
theorem morita_backward_interleaving {M₁ M₂ : Type} {τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁}
    {τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂} (B : DistortedBiInterpretation τ₁ τ₂) (m : Nat) (x y : M₁)
    (h : pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv (B.a' * m + B.b')) x y) : τ₁.equiv m x y :=
  τ₁.trans (B.unit_equiv m x)
    (τ₁.trans (B.backward_bound m (B.I x) (B.I y) h) (τ₁.symm (B.unit_equiv m y)))
/-- Floor-bound corollary: for `k ≥ b'`, `I*(≡_k^{T₂}) ⊆ (≡_{⌊(k - b') / a'⌋}^{T₁})`. -/
theorem morita_backward_floor_bound {M₁ M₂ : Type} {τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁}
    {τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂} (B : DistortedBiInterpretation τ₁ τ₂) (k : Nat)
    (hbk : B.b' ≤ k) (x y : M₁) (h : pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv k) x y) :
    τ₁.equiv ((k - B.b') / B.a') x y := by
  have h2 := Nat.add_le_add_right (morita_mul_div_le B.a' (k - B.b')) B.b'
  rw [morita_sub_add_cancel hbk] at h2
  exact morita_backward_interleaving B ((k - B.b') / B.a') x y (τ₂.anti h2 h)
/-- Asymptotic `k = ∞` invariance: `⋂_k ≡_k^{T₁} ↔ I*(⋂_k ≡_k^{T₂})`. -/
theorem morita_inf_invariance {M₁ M₂ : Type} {τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁}
    {τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂} (B : DistortedBiInterpretation τ₁ τ₂) (x y : M₁) :
    τ₁.infEquiv x y ↔ pullbackRel B.I τ₂.infEquiv x y :=
  ⟨fun h k ↦ morita_forward_interleaving B k x y (h (B.a * k + B.b)),
   fun h m ↦ morita_backward_interleaving B m x y (h (B.a' * m + B.b'))⟩
/-- **Quasi-Isometric Morita Resource Interleaving (Bundled Witness, Emerald):**
    Certifies both finite-level interleaving bounds, the floor corollary, and exact
    `k = ∞` invariance across any distorted bi-interpretation (zero axioms). -/
theorem morita_resource_interleaving {M₁ M₂ : Type} {τ₁ : DescendingResourceTower M₁}
    {τ₂ : DescendingResourceTower M₂} (B : DistortedBiInterpretation τ₁ τ₂) :
    (∀ k x y, τ₁.equiv (B.a * k + B.b) x y → pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv k) x y) ∧
    (∀ m x y, pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv (B.a' * m + B.b')) x y → τ₁.equiv m x y) ∧
    (∀ k, B.b' ≤ k → ∀ x y,
      pullbackRel B.I (τ₂.equiv k) x y → τ₁.equiv ((k - B.b') / B.a') x y) ∧
    (∀ x y, τ₁.infEquiv x y ↔ pullbackRel B.I τ₂.infEquiv x y) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
exact ⟨morita_forward_interleaving B, morita_backward_interleaving B,
    morita_backward_floor_bound B, morita_inf_invariance B⟩

nodes.statement: Let T1 be the theory of pairs of socks (carrier X, pair equivalence E, irreflexive symmetric mismatch relation D subseteq E \ Delta_X) and T2 be its Morita-equivalent quotient presentation adjoining pair sort Q = X / E, projection graph G_pi, and definable quotient predicate Mis(q). Certify constructively with zero axioms (Emerald): (1) an explicit model bijection SockModelT1 equiv SockModelT2 (J(I(M)) = M), (2) two-sock models matchedPair and mismatchedPair satisfy matchedPair equiv_1^E mismatchedPair in T1, (3) I(matchedPair) not equiv_1^E I(mismatchedPair) already at k = 1 in T2, and (4) matchedPair not equiv_2^E mismatchedPair separates at k = 2 in T1.

private def listGetBool : List Bool → Nat → Bool
  | [] => fun _ => false
  | b :: tl => fun n => match n with | 0 => b | k + 1 => listGetBool tl k
private theorem natBeq_refl (m : Nat) : Nat.beq m m = true := by
  induction m with | zero => rfl | succ _ ih => exact ih
private theorem natBeq_eq : ∀ {m n : Nat}, Nat.beq m n = true → m = n
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl | _ + 1, _ + 1, h => congrArg Nat.succ (natBeq_eq h)
  | 0, _ + 1, h => False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h)
  | _ + 1, 0, h => False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h)
private theorem fin1_absurd {n : Nat} (h : n + 1 < 1) : False :=
  Nat.not_lt_zero n (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)
/-- Finite paired-sock model of `T₁`: carrier `X = Fin n × Bool`, pair equivalence `E`,
    and irreflexive symmetric mismatch relation `D ⊆ E \ Δ_X`. -/
structure SockModelT1 : Type where
  /-- Bit vector recording for each pair `i` whether its two socks are mismatched. -/
  pairMismatch : List Bool
/-- Morita-equivalent quotient model of `T₂` adjoining pair sort `Q = X / E`, projection
    graph `G_π`, and definable quotient predicate `Mis(q)`. -/
structure SockModelT2 : Type where
  /-- Quotient mismatch predicate `Mis` on pair sort `Q = Fin n`. -/
  quotMis : List Bool
/-- Forward Morita interpretation `I : SockModelT1 → SockModelT2`. -/
def sockI (M : SockModelT1) : SockModelT2 := ⟨M.pairMismatch⟩
/-- Backward Morita interpretation `J : SockModelT2 → SockModelT1`. -/
def sockJ (N : SockModelT2) : SockModelT1 := ⟨N.quotMis⟩
/-- Explicit Morita model bijection `SockModelT1 ≃ SockModelT2` (`J(I(M)) = M`). -/
def sockModelEquiv : SockModelT1 ≃ SockModelT2 where
  toFun := sockI; invFun := sockJ; left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl; right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
/-- Sock carrier `X = Fin n × Bool` of a `T₁` model. -/
def SockModelT1.Sock (M : SockModelT1) : Type := Fin M.pairMismatch.length × Bool
/-- Pair equivalence relation `E` on `M.Sock`. -/
def SockModelT1.E (_M : SockModelT1) (x y : _M.Sock) : Bool := Nat.beq x.1.val y.1.val
/-- Irreflexive mismatch relation `D ⊆ E \ Δ_X` on `M.Sock`. -/
def SockModelT1.D (M : SockModelT1) (x y : M.Sock) : Bool :=
  Nat.beq x.1.val y.1.val && (x.2 != y.2) && listGetBool M.pairMismatch x.1.val
/-- Two-sorted carrier `X ⊔ Q` of a `T₂` quotient model. -/
def SockModelT2.Elem (N : SockModelT2) : Type :=
  Sum (Fin N.quotMis.length × Bool) (Fin N.quotMis.length)
/-- Sort predicate for sock elements `x ∈ X`. -/
def SockModelT2.isSock {N : SockModelT2} : N.Elem → Bool | .inl _ => true | .inr _ => false
/-- Sort predicate for pair quotient elements `q ∈ Q = X / E`. -/
def SockModelT2.isPair {N : SockModelT2} : N.Elem → Bool | .inl _ => false | .inr _ => true
/-- Pair equivalence relation `E` lifted to `N.Elem`. -/
def SockModelT2.E (_N : SockModelT2) : _N.Elem → _N.Elem → Bool
  | .inl x => fun y => match y with | .inl y => Nat.beq x.1.val y.1.val | .inr _ => false
  | .inr _ => fun _ => false
/-- Mismatch relation `D` lifted to `N.Elem`. -/
def SockModelT2.D (N : SockModelT2) : N.Elem → N.Elem → Bool
  | .inl x => fun y => match y with
    | .inl y => Nat.beq x.1.val y.1.val && (x.2 != y.2) && listGetBool N.quotMis x.1.val
    | .inr _ => false
  | .inr _ => fun _ => false
/-- Projection graph `G_π(x, q)` relating sock `x` to its pair `q = [x]_E`. -/
def SockModelT2.Gpi (_N : SockModelT2) : _N.Elem → _N.Elem → Bool
  | .inl x => fun y => match y with | .inr q => Nat.beq x.1.val q.val | .inl _ => false
  | .inr _ => fun _ => false
/-- Definable unary quotient predicate `Mis(q)` on the pair sort `Q`. -/
def SockModelT2.Mis (N : SockModelT2) : N.Elem → Bool
  | .inl _ => false | .inr q => listGetBool N.quotMis q.val
/-- Definability of `Mis(q)` from `(G_π, D)` inside `T₂` (zero axioms). -/
theorem sockT2_mis_definable (N : SockModelT2) (q : Fin N.quotMis.length) :
    N.Mis (.inr q) = true ↔
    ∃ x y : N.Elem, N.Gpi x (.inr q) = true ∧ N.Gpi y (.inr q) = true ∧ N.D x y = true := by
  constructor
  · intro hMis; refine ⟨.inl (q, false), .inl (q, true), natBeq_refl _, natBeq_refl _, ?_⟩
    change (Nat.beq q.val q.val && true && N.Mis (.inr q)) = true
    rw [natBeq_refl, hMis]; rfl
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hD⟩
    cases x with | inr _ => exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion hx) | inl sx =>
    cases y with | inr _ => exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion hy) | inl sy =>
    change listGetBool N.quotMis q.val = true; rw [← natBeq_eq hx]
    dsimp only [SockModelT2.D] at hD; cases hM : listGetBool N.quotMis sx.1.val
    · rw [hM] at hD; cases hb : Nat.beq sx.1.val sy.1.val && (sx.2 != sy.2) <;>
        rw [hb] at hD <;> exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion hD)
    · rfl
/-- Partial isomorphism condition in `T₁` across played sock pebble pairs. -/
def PartialIsoT1 (M₁ M₂ : SockModelT1) (ps : List (M₁.Sock × M₂.Sock)) : Prop :=
  ∀ p₁, p₁ ∈ ps → ∀ p₂, p₂ ∈ ps → (p₁.1 = p₂.1 ↔ p₁.2 = p₂.2) ∧
    (M₁.E p₁.1 p₂.1 = M₂.E p₁.2 p₂.2) ∧ (M₁.D p₁.1 p₂.1 = M₂.D p₁.2 p₂.2)
/-- Inductive `k`-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé game on `T₁` models. -/
def efGameT1 (M₁ M₂ : SockModelT1) : Nat → List (M₁.Sock × M₂.Sock) → Prop
  | 0, ps => PartialIsoT1 M₁ M₂ ps
  | k + 1, ps => PartialIsoT1 M₁ M₂ ps ∧
    (∀ x : M₁.Sock, ∃ y : M₂.Sock, efGameT1 M₁ M₂ k ((x, y) :: ps)) ∧
    (∀ y : M₂.Sock, ∃ x : M₁.Sock, efGameT1 M₁ M₂ k ((x, y) :: ps))
/-- `k`-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé equivalence `M₁ ≡_k^E M₂` in `T₁`. -/
def efEquivT1 (k : Nat) (M₁ M₂ : SockModelT1) : Prop := efGameT1 M₁ M₂ k []
/-- Partial isomorphism condition in `T₂` across played two-sorted pebble pairs. -/
def PartialIsoT2 (N₁ N₂ : SockModelT2) (ps : List (N₁.Elem × N₂.Elem)) : Prop :=
  ∀ p₁, p₁ ∈ ps → ∀ p₂, p₂ ∈ ps →
    (p₁.1 = p₂.1 ↔ p₁.2 = p₂.2) ∧ (N₁.isSock p₁.1 = N₂.isSock p₁.2) ∧
    (N₁.isPair p₁.1 = N₂.isPair p₁.2) ∧ (N₁.Mis p₁.1 = N₂.Mis p₁.2) ∧
    (N₁.E p₁.1 p₂.1 = N₂.E p₁.2 p₂.2) ∧ (N₁.D p₁.1 p₂.1 = N₂.D p₁.2 p₂.2) ∧
    (N₁.Gpi p₁.1 p₂.1 = N₂.Gpi p₁.2 p₂.2)
/-- Inductive `k`-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé game on `T₂` models. -/
def efGameT2 (N₁ N₂ : SockModelT2) : Nat → List (N₁.Elem × N₂.Elem) → Prop
  | 0, ps => PartialIsoT2 N₁ N₂ ps
  | k + 1, ps => PartialIsoT2 N₁ N₂ ps ∧
    (∀ u : N₁.Elem, ∃ v : N₂.Elem, efGameT2 N₁ N₂ k ((u, v) :: ps)) ∧
    (∀ v : N₂.Elem, ∃ u : N₁.Elem, efGameT2 N₁ N₂ k ((u, v) :: ps))
/-- `k`-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé equivalence `N₁ ≡_k^E N₂` in `T₂`. -/
def efEquivT2 (k : Nat) (N₁ N₂ : SockModelT2) : Prop := efGameT2 N₁ N₂ k []
/-- Single matched 2-sock pair (`D = ∅`). -/
def matchedPair : SockModelT1 := ⟨[false]⟩
/-- Single mismatched 2-sock pair (`D = {((0,false),(0,true)), ((0,true),(0,false))}`). -/
def mismatchedPair : SockModelT1 := ⟨[true]⟩
private theorem single_pair_partialIsoT1 (x : matchedPair.Sock) :
    PartialIsoT1 matchedPair mismatchedPair [(x, x)] := fun p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ ↦ by
  cases hp₁ with | tail _ h => cases h | head =>
  cases hp₂ with | tail _ h => cases h | head =>
  refine ⟨Iff.rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  rcases x with ⟨⟨_ | n, hiv⟩, b⟩
  · cases b <;> rfl
  · exact False.elim (fin1_absurd hiv)
/-- `matchedPair ≡_1^E mismatchedPair` holds at `k = 1` in `T₁` (zero axioms). -/
theorem russells_socks_t1_equiv_1 : efEquivT1 1 matchedPair mismatchedPair :=
  ⟨fun _ h ↦ False.elim (by cases h),
   fun x ↦ ⟨x, single_pair_partialIsoT1 x⟩, fun y ↦ ⟨y, single_pair_partialIsoT1 y⟩⟩
/-- `I(matchedPair) ≢_1^E I(mismatchedPair)` fails already at `k = 1` in `T₂` (zero axioms). -/
theorem russells_socks_t2_not_equiv_1 :
    ¬ efEquivT2 1 (sockI matchedPair) (sockI mismatchedPair) := by
  intro h; rcases h.2.1 (.inr ⟨0, by decide⟩) with ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hpair := hv (.inr ⟨0, by decide⟩, v) (List.Mem.head _)
    (.inr ⟨0, by decide⟩, v) (List.Mem.head _)
  cases v with | inl _ => exact Bool.noConfusion hpair.2.2.1 | inr q =>
  rcases q with ⟨_ | _, hqv⟩
  · exact Bool.noConfusion hpair.2.2.2.1
  · exact False.elim (fin1_absurd hqv)
/-- `matchedPair ≢_2^E mismatchedPair` separates at `k = 2` in `T₁` (zero axioms). -/
theorem russells_socks_t1_not_equiv_2 : ¬ efEquivT1 2 matchedPair mismatchedPair := by
  intro h; rcases h.2.1 (⟨0, by decide⟩, false) with ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩
  rcases hy₁.2.1 (⟨0, by decide⟩, true) with ⟨y₂, hy₂⟩
  have hStep := hy₂ ((⟨0, by decide⟩, false), y₁) (List.Mem.tail _ (List.Mem.head _))
    ((⟨0, by decide⟩, true), y₂) (List.Mem.head _)
  have hNeq : y₁ ≠ y₂ := fun heq ↦ Bool.noConfusion (congrArg Prod.snd (hStep.1.mpr heq))
  rcases y₁ with ⟨⟨_ | _, hi₁⟩, b₁⟩ <;> rcases y₂ with ⟨⟨_ | _, hi₂⟩, b₂⟩ <;> first
  | (cases b₁ <;> cases b₂ <;> first | exact hNeq rfl | exact Bool.noConfusion hStep.2.2)
  | exact False.elim (fin1_absurd hi₂) | exact False.elim (fin1_absurd hi₁)
/-- **Russell's Socks Levelwise Morita Failure (Emerald):** Explicit model bijection
    `SockModelT1 ≃ SockModelT2` witnessing `k = 1` equivalence in `T₁`, `k = 1` failure
    in `T₂`, and `k = 2` separation in `T₁` (zero axioms). -/
theorem russells_socks_levelwise_morita_failure :
    (∀ M : SockModelT1, sockJ (sockI M) = M) ∧ (∀ N : SockModelT2, sockI (sockJ N) = N) ∧
    efEquivT1 1 matchedPair mismatchedPair ∧
    ¬ efEquivT2 1 (sockI matchedPair) (sockI mismatchedPair) ∧
    ¬ efEquivT1 2 matchedPair mismatchedPair := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
nodes.lean_body:
exact ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun _ ↦ rfl, russells_socks_t1_equiv_1, russells_socks_t2_not_equiv_1,
    russells_socks_t1_not_equiv_2⟩

\begin{proposition}[Volume~I Grounding Contract: Unbundling Limitation of Size Over $\mathsf{GB}_0$]\label{vol1:prop:los-smuggles-gc}%
Pinned read-only to Volume~I (\texttt{prop:los-smuggles-gc}, \texttt{docs/ch07\_sets\_residuum.tex:135}, Zenodo DOI \texttt{10.5281/zenodo.24238086})~\cite{godel1940}. Over Replacement-free, Choice-free class theory $\mathsf{GB}_0$, von Neumann's Limitation of Size ($\mathsf{LoS}$: $C \notin \mathcal{S} \iff C \twoheadrightarrow V$) satisfies
\[
  \mathsf{GB}_0 \;\vdash\; \mathsf{LoS} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; (\mathrm{Rep} \wedge \mathsf{GC}).
\]
In particular, $\mathsf{GB}_0 + \mathsf{LoS}$ coincides with full $\mathsf{NBG}$, smuggling Global Choice across Choice-free bases, while $\mathsf{GB}_0 + \mathsf{GC} \not\vdash \mathsf{LoS}$ as witnessed by G\"odel's $(L_{\omega_\omega^L}, \mathrm{Def}(L_{\omega_\omega^L}))$.
\end{proposition}

nodes.tex:
Part~I turns the residuum calculus developed in the Overture onto the class--set projection {{sym:piset}} anchored in Volume~I ({{ref:vol1:def:set-projection-fibration}} and {{ref:vol1:prop:los-smuggles-gc}}). In \S 2.1, Definition~\ref{ch02:def:gb0-model-category} constructs the two-sorted model category {{sym:mod-gb0}} of Replacement-free G\"odel class algebras closed under \textbf{G1--G8} and Subclass Separation~\cite{godel1940,joyal_moerdijk1995}, and Theorem~\ref{ch02:thm:three-way-pullback-failure} certifies constructively that naive trace pullback $f^*\mathcal{D} := \{f^{-1}[D] \mid D \in \mathcal{D}\}$ breaks along three independent obstructions: Subclass Separation leakage, G\"odel \textbf{G4} domain-projection failure, and preimage collapse.

To repair this non-fibrational failure in \S 2.2, Theorem~\ref{ch02:thm:def-left-adjoint-coreflection} proves that minimal parameter-definable expansion ${{sym:def-functor}}$ is \emph{left adjoint} to {{sym:piset}} (${{sym:def-functor}} \dashv {{sym:piset}}$) with identity unit $\eta_M$ and vertical inclusion counit $\varepsilon_{(M,\mathcal{C})}$---embedding $\mathbf{DefAlg}$ as a \textbf{full coreflective subcategory} of {{sym:mod-gb0}} whose coreflector is {{sym:piset}}~\cite{maclane1998}, with ${{sym:def-functor}}(M)$ initial in every vertical fiber ${{sym:piset}}^{-1}(M)$. Proposition~\ref{ch02:prop:syntactic-conservative-pullback} contrasts this semantic obstruction with the syntactic theory lattice, where $\mathcal{L}_\in$-conservative class extensions form genuine pullback squares against minimal expansions until Replacement or Foundation fails (previewing Chapter~3~\cite{felgner1971}).

Sections~2.3--2.4 dissect the vertical fiber ${{sym:piset}}^{-1}(M)$ above a fixed set floor. Proposition~\ref{ch02:prop:los-unbundling-independence} proves $\mathsf{LoS} \iff (\mathrm{Rep} \wedge \mathsf{GC})$ over {{sym:gb0}} together with $2\times 2$ independence models for Easton's $\mathrm{Rep} \wedge \neg\mathsf{GC}$~\cite{easton1970} and $(L_{\omega_\omega^L}, {{sym:def-functor}}(L_{\omega_\omega^L})) \models \mathsf{GC} \wedge \neg\mathrm{Rep}$. Claim~\ref{ch02:claim:easton-hod-unsplit-card} notes that Easton's $\forall p\,(V \neq \mathrm{HOD}(\{p\}))$ (unlike bare $V \neq \mathrm{HOD}$, where $L[c]$ still splits) leaves Makkai's weak equivalence $\mathbf{Card} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Set}$ unsplit~\cite{makkai1996}, while Theorem~\ref{ch02:thm:williams-fixed-set-kaleidoscope} combines Williams's Fixed-Set Universality Theorem~\cite{williams2018} with an axiom-free principal-ideal order embedding. Finally, Claims~\ref{ch02:claim:gitman-etr-ord-fujimoto-contrast} and~\ref{ch02:claim:kelley-morse-freyd-kan-barrier} calibrate the upper spectrum through {{sym:etr-ord}} (flagging that \cite{gitman2020} write $\mathsf{GBC}$ for ${{sym:nbg}}$ and that Tarskian truth predicates at $\mathsf{ETR}_\omega$ already prove $\mathrm{Con}(\mathsf{ZFC})$, contrasting with $\mathcal{L}_\in$-conservative $\mathsf{CT}^-[\mathsf{ZFC}]$~\cite{fujimoto2012}) up to {{sym:km}} and Freyd's large-limit barrier~\cite{simpson2009,maclane1998}, synthesized in Table~\ref{ch02:tab:vertical-class-spectrum}.

nodes.statement: A GB0Model is a two-sorted set-and-class structure (M, C) over a pairing-equipped set universe M = (Carrier, mem, pair) closed under extensional membership equivalence, singleton and set parameters, Godel's eight finite predicative class operations G1-G8 (including G4 domain projection domClass), and Subclass Separation (every class C in C bounded by a set a in M is represented by a set b in M). Together with elementary two-sorted morphisms (f, F) : (M, C) -> (N, D) preserving membership, pairing, Godel expression satisfaction (L_in-elementarity), and Godel expressions, Mod(GB_0) carries the forgetful projection functor piSet : Mod(GB_0) -> SetBase.
nodes.tex:
\begin{definition}[The Category {{sym:mod-gb0}} of G\"odel Class Algebras and Projection {{sym:piset}}]\label{ch02:def:gb0-model-category}%
\uses{vol1:def:set-projection-fibration}%
Relative to Volume~I ({{ref:vol1:def:set-projection-fibration}}), a \textbf{G\"odel class algebra} $(M, \mathcal{C}) \in {{sym:mod-gb0}}$ consists of a pairing-equipped set structure $M = (|M|, \in_M, \langle -, - \rangle_M)$ together with a collection $\mathcal{C} \subseteq \wp(|M|)$ closed under extensional equivalence, singleton and set parameters, G\"odel's eight predicative class operations \textbf{G1--G8} (including \textbf{G4} domain projection $\mathrm{dom}^M(C) := \{x \mid \exists y,\; (x, y) \in C\}$)~\cite{godel1940,joyal_moerdijk1995}, and \textbf{Subclass Separation}: every $C \in \mathcal{C}$ bounded by a set $a \in M$ is represented by a set $b \in M$. Morphisms $(f, F) : (M, \mathcal{C}) \to (N, \mathcal{D})$ in {{sym:mod-gb0}} pair an $\mathcal{L}_\in$-elementary set-base embedding $f : M \hookrightarrow N$ (preserving $\in$, pairs, satisfaction, and extensional equivalences of parameterized G\"odel expressions) with a membership- and G\"odel-preserving class transport $F : \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{D}$, and {{sym:piset}} sends $(M, \mathcal{C}) \mapsto M$, $(f, F) \mapsto f$.
\end{definition}

/-- First-order set carrier equipped with membership and injective Kuratowski pairing. -/
structure SetBase : Type 1 where
  /-- Domain of sets, membership `∈`, ordered pairing, and pair injectivity. -/
  Carrier : Type
  mem : Carrier → Carrier → Prop
  pair : Carrier → Carrier → Carrier
  pair_inj : ∀ {x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : Carrier}, pair x₁ y₁ = pair x₂ y₂ → x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂

/-- Gödel G1: Membership relation `{(x, y) | x ∈ y}`. -/
def gb0MemRel (M : SetBase) : Set M.Carrier := fun z ↦ ∃ x y, z = M.pair x y ∧ M.mem x y
/-- Gödel G2: Class intersection `C ∩ D`. -/
def gb0Inter {α : Type} (C D : Set α) : Set α := fun x ↦ C x ∧ D x
/-- Gödel G3: Class complement `V \ C`. -/
def gb0Compl {α : Type} (C : Set α) : Set α := fun x ↦ ¬ C x
/-- Gödel G4: Domain projection `dom(C) = {x | ∃ y, (x, y) ∈ C}`. -/
def domClass (M : SetBase) (C : Set M.Carrier) : Set M.Carrier := fun x ↦ ∃ y, C (M.pair x y)
/-- Gödel G5: Left-cylinder product `C × V`. -/
def gb0ProdV (M : SetBase) (C : Set M.Carrier) : Set M.Carrier :=
  fun z ↦ ∃ x y, z = M.pair x y ∧ C x
/-- Gödel G6: Pair converse `{(x, y) | (y, x) ∈ C}`. -/
def gb0Converse (M : SetBase) (C : Set M.Carrier) : Set M.Carrier :=
  fun z ↦ ∃ x y, z = M.pair x y ∧ C (M.pair y x)
/-- Gödel G7: Right cyclic permutation of triples. -/
def gb0CycleRight (M : SetBase) (C : Set M.Carrier) : Set M.Carrier :=
  fun w ↦ ∃ x y z, w = M.pair x (M.pair y z) ∧ C (M.pair y (M.pair z x))
/-- Gödel G8: Inner pair transposition of triples. -/
def gb0SwapInner (M : SetBase) (C : Set M.Carrier) : Set M.Carrier :=
  fun w ↦ ∃ x y z, w = M.pair x (M.pair y z) ∧ C (M.pair x (M.pair z y))
/-- Subclass Separation: any class bounded by a set `a` is represented by a set `b`. -/
def SatisfiesSubclassSep (M : SetBase) (IsClass : Set M.Carrier → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ C : Set M.Carrier, IsClass C →
    (∃ a : M.Carrier, ∀ x, C x → M.mem x a) → ∃ b : M.Carrier, ∀ x, M.mem x b ↔ C x

/-- Parameterized Gödel G1–G8 expressions generating minimal definable classes `Def(M)`. -/
inductive GodelExpr (P : Type) : Type
  | singleton (p : P) | setElts (p : P) | memRel | inter (e₁ e₂ : GodelExpr P)
  | compl (e : GodelExpr P) | dom (e : GodelExpr P) | prodV (e : GodelExpr P)
  | converse (e : GodelExpr P) | cycleRight (e : GodelExpr P) | swapInner (e : GodelExpr P)

/-- Translate parameters in a `GodelExpr` along `f : P → Q`. -/
def GodelExpr.map {P Q : Type} (f : P → Q) : GodelExpr P → GodelExpr Q
  | .singleton p => .singleton (f p) | .setElts p => .setElts (f p) | .memRel => .memRel
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => .inter (e₁.map f) (e₂.map f) | .compl e => .compl (e.map f)
  | .dom e => .dom (e.map f) | .prodV e => .prodV (e.map f)
  | .converse e => .converse (e.map f) | .cycleRight e => .cycleRight (e.map f)
  | .swapInner e => .swapInner (e.map f)

/-- Identity law for `GodelExpr.map`. -/
theorem GodelExpr.map_id {P : Type} : ∀ e : GodelExpr P, e.map id = e
  | .singleton _ | .setElts _ | .memRel => rfl
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e₁, map_id e₂]
  | .compl e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]
  | .dom e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]
  | .prodV e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]
  | .converse e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]
  | .cycleRight e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]
  | .swapInner e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_id e]

/-- Composition law for `GodelExpr.map`. -/
theorem GodelExpr.map_comp {P Q R : Type} (f : P → Q) (g : Q → R) :
    ∀ e : GodelExpr P, e.map (g ∘ f) = (e.map f).map g
  | .singleton _ | .setElts _ | .memRel => rfl
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e₁, map_comp f g e₂]
  | .compl e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]
  | .dom e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]
  | .prodV e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]
  | .converse e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]
  | .cycleRight e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]
  | .swapInner e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_comp f g e]

/-- Pointwise congruence for `GodelExpr.map` (axiom-free, avoiding `funext`). -/
theorem GodelExpr.map_congr {P Q : Type} {f g : P → Q} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) :
    ∀ e : GodelExpr P, e.map f = e.map g
  | .singleton p => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [h p]
  | .setElts p => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [h p]
  | .memRel => rfl
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e₁, map_congr h e₂]
  | .compl e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]
  | .dom e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]
  | .prodV e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]
  | .converse e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]
  | .cycleRight e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]
  | .swapInner e => by dsimp only [GodelExpr.map]; rw [map_congr h e]

/-- Extensional evaluation of a `GodelExpr` inside a `SetBase`. -/
def evalGodelExpr (M : SetBase) : GodelExpr M.Carrier → Set M.Carrier
  | .singleton p => fun x ↦ x = p | .setElts p => fun x ↦ M.mem x p | .memRel => gb0MemRel M
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => gb0Inter (evalGodelExpr M e₁) (evalGodelExpr M e₂)
  | .compl e => gb0Compl (evalGodelExpr M e) | .dom e => domClass M (evalGodelExpr M e)
  | .prodV e => gb0ProdV M (evalGodelExpr M e) | .converse e => gb0Converse M (evalGodelExpr M e)
  | .cycleRight e => gb0CycleRight M (evalGodelExpr M e)
  | .swapInner e => gb0SwapInner M (evalGodelExpr M e)

/-- Two-sorted model `(M, C)` of Replacement-free Bernays–Gödel class theory `GB₀`. -/
structure GB0Model : Type 1 where
  /-- Base universe, classes, extensionality, singletons/sets, G1–G8, and Subclass Sep. -/
  base : SetBase
  IsClass : Set base.Carrier → Prop
  ext_mem : ∀ {C D}, (∀ x, C x ↔ D x) → IsClass C → IsClass D
  singleton_mem : ∀ p, IsClass (fun x ↦ x = p)
  set_mem : ∀ p, IsClass (fun x ↦ base.mem x p)
  g1_memRel : IsClass (gb0MemRel base)
  g2_inter : ∀ {C D}, IsClass C → IsClass D → IsClass (gb0Inter C D)
  g3_compl : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (gb0Compl C)
  g4_dom : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (domClass base C)
  g5_prodV : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (gb0ProdV base C)
  g6_converse : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (gb0Converse base C)
  g7_cycleRight : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (gb0CycleRight base C)
  g8_swapInner : ∀ {C}, IsClass C → IsClass (gb0SwapInner base C)
  subclass_sep : SatisfiesSubclassSep base IsClass

/-- Every Gödel expression evaluates to an admissible class inside any `GB0Model`. -/
theorem evalGodelExpr_isClass (X : GB0Model) :
    ∀ e : GodelExpr X.base.Carrier, X.IsClass (evalGodelExpr X.base e)
  | .singleton p => X.singleton_mem p | .setElts p => X.set_mem p | .memRel => X.g1_memRel
  | .inter e₁ e₂ => X.g2_inter (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e₁) (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e₂)
  | .compl e => X.g3_compl (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)
  | .dom e => X.g4_dom (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)
  | .prodV e => X.g5_prodV (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)
  | .converse e => X.g6_converse (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)
  | .cycleRight e => X.g7_cycleRight (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)
  | .swapInner e => X.g8_swapInner (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)

/-- Elementary `L_∈`-embedding preserving `∈`, pairing, and Gödel formulas/equalities. -/
structure SetBaseHom (M N : SetBase) : Type where
  /-- Embedding map, membership iff, pair preservation, and Gödel elementarity. -/
  toFun : M.Carrier → N.Carrier
  mem_iff : ∀ x y, M.mem x y ↔ N.mem (toFun x) (toFun y)
  pair_map : ∀ x y, toFun (M.pair x y) = N.pair (toFun x) (toFun y)
  elem_iff : ∀ (e : GodelExpr M.Carrier) (x : M.Carrier),
    evalGodelExpr M e x ↔ evalGodelExpr N (e.map toFun) (toFun x)
  elem_ext : ∀ e₁ e₂ : GodelExpr M.Carrier,
    (∀ x, evalGodelExpr M e₁ x ↔ evalGodelExpr M e₂ x) →
    ∀ y, evalGodelExpr N (e₁.map toFun) y ↔ evalGodelExpr N (e₂.map toFun) y

/-- Identity morphism on a `SetBase`. -/
def SetBaseHom.id (M : SetBase) : SetBaseHom M M where
  toFun := _root_.id; mem_iff _ _ := Iff.rfl; pair_map _ _ := rfl
  elem_iff e x := by
    change evalGodelExpr M e x ↔ evalGodelExpr M (e.map _root_.id) x
    rw [GodelExpr.map_id]
  elem_ext e₁ e₂ h y := by
    rw [GodelExpr.map_id, GodelExpr.map_id]; exact h y

/-- Composition of `SetBaseHom` morphisms. -/
def SetBaseHom.comp {L M N : SetBase} (f : SetBaseHom L M) (g : SetBaseHom M N) :
    SetBaseHom L N where
  toFun := g.toFun ∘ f.toFun
  mem_iff x y := (f.mem_iff x y).trans (g.mem_iff (f.toFun x) (f.toFun y))
  pair_map x y := by dsimp; rw [f.pair_map, g.pair_map]
  elem_iff e x := (f.elem_iff e x).trans (by
    change evalGodelExpr M (e.map f.toFun) (f.toFun x) ↔
      evalGodelExpr N (e.map (g.toFun ∘ f.toFun)) (g.toFun (f.toFun x))
    rw [GodelExpr.map_comp]; exact g.elem_iff (e.map f.toFun) (f.toFun x))
  elem_ext e₁ e₂ h y := by
    rw [GodelExpr.map_comp, GodelExpr.map_comp]
    exact g.elem_ext (e₁.map f.toFun) (e₂.map f.toFun) (f.elem_ext e₁ e₂ h) y

/-- Pointwise extensional equality of `SetBaseHom` morphisms (axiom-free). -/
def SetBaseHom.Eq {M N : SetBase} (f g : SetBaseHom M N) : Prop := ∀ x, f.toFun x = g.toFun x

/-- Two-sorted `GB₀` morphism `(f, F) : (M, C) → (N, D)`. -/
structure GB0Hom (X Y : GB0Model) : Type where
  /-- Base embedding, class transport, extensionality, `∈`-preservation, and Gödel transport. -/
  baseHom : SetBaseHom X.base Y.base
  classMap : {C : Set X.base.Carrier // X.IsClass C} → {D : Set Y.base.Carrier // Y.IsClass D}
  classMap_ext : ∀ C₁ C₂ : {C // X.IsClass C},
    (∀ x, C₁.1 x ↔ C₂.1 x) → ∀ y, (classMap C₁).1 y ↔ (classMap C₂).1 y
  mem_preserve : ∀ C : {C // X.IsClass C}, ∀ x, C.1 x ↔ (classMap C).1 (baseHom.toFun x)
  map_godel : ∀ e : GodelExpr X.base.Carrier, ∀ y,
    (classMap ⟨evalGodelExpr X.base e, evalGodelExpr_isClass X e⟩).1 y ↔
      evalGodelExpr Y.base (e.map baseHom.toFun) y

/-- Identity two-sorted morphism in `Mod(GB₀)`. -/
def GB0Hom.id (X : GB0Model) : GB0Hom X X where
  baseHom := SetBaseHom.id X.base; classMap := _root_.id
  classMap_ext _ _ h y := h y; mem_preserve _ _ := Iff.rfl
  map_godel e y := by
    change evalGodelExpr X.base e y ↔ evalGodelExpr X.base (e.map _root_.id) y
    rw [GodelExpr.map_id]

/-- Composition of two-sorted morphisms in `Mod(GB₀)`. -/
def GB0Hom.comp {X Y Z : GB0Model} (f : GB0Hom X Y) (g : GB0Hom Y Z) : GB0Hom X Z where
  baseHom := SetBaseHom.comp f.baseHom g.baseHom; classMap := g.classMap ∘ f.classMap
  classMap_ext C₁ C₂ h := g.classMap_ext _ _ (f.classMap_ext C₁ C₂ h)
  mem_preserve C x := (f.mem_preserve C x).trans (g.mem_preserve (f.classMap C) (f.baseHom.toFun x))
  map_godel e z := by
    have h₁ := g.classMap_ext (f.classMap ⟨evalGodelExpr X.base e, evalGodelExpr_isClass X e⟩)
      ⟨evalGodelExpr Y.base (e.map f.baseHom.toFun), evalGodelExpr_isClass Y _⟩ (f.map_godel e) z
    have h₂ := g.map_godel (e.map f.baseHom.toFun) z
    change _ ↔ evalGodelExpr Z.base (e.map (g.baseHom.toFun ∘ f.baseHom.toFun)) z
    rw [GodelExpr.map_comp]; exact h₁.trans h₂

/-- Pointwise extensional equivalence of `GB0Hom` morphisms (axiom-free). -/
def GB0Hom.Eq {X Y : GB0Model} (φ ψ : GB0Hom X Y) : Prop :=
  SetBaseHom.Eq φ.baseHom ψ.baseHom ∧ ∀ C y, (φ.classMap C).1 y ↔ (ψ.classMap C).1 y

/-- Forgetful object projection `π_Set : Mod(GB₀) → SetBase`. -/
@[reducible] def piSet (X : GB0Model) : SetBase := X.base
/-- Forgetful morphism projection `π_Set : GB0Hom X Y → SetBaseHom X.base Y.base`. -/
@[reducible] def piSetMap {X Y : GB0Model} (φ : GB0Hom X Y) : SetBaseHom (piSet X) (piSet Y) :=
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
/-- Functorial identity law for `π_Set`. -/
theorem piSetMap_id (X : GB0Model) :
    SetBaseHom.Eq (piSetMap (GB0Hom.id X)) (SetBaseHom.id (piSet X)) := fun _ ↦ rfl
/-- Functorial composition law for `π_Set`. -/
theorem piSetMap_comp {X Y Z : GB0Model} (φ : GB0Hom X Y) (ψ : GB0Hom Y Z) :
    SetBaseHom.Eq (piSetMap (GB0Hom.comp φ ψ)) (SetBaseHom.comp (piSetMap φ) (piSetMap ψ)) :=
  fun _ ↦ rfl

nodes.statement: Over Mod(GB_0), naive trace pullback f^*D := {f^{-1}[D] | D in D} along an in- and pair-preserving embedding f : M_fin -> M_full fails simultaneously along three independent obstructions, blocking Cartesian lifts for pi_Set: (1) Subclass Separation Leak: evenNat in Def(M_full) pulls back onto a bounded subset of omega in M_fin with no representing set in M_fin; (2) Godel G4 Domain-Projection Failure: for D = {(f(x_0), y_0)} with external witness y_0 not in range(f), dom^{M_fin}(f^{-1}[D]) = empty != {x_0} = f^{-1}[dom^{M_full}(D)]; (3) Preimage Collapse: distinct classes empty != {y_0} in D satisfy f^{-1}[empty] = empty = f^{-1}[{y_0}], blocking unique Cartesian mediating lifts.

private def listLookupProp (n : Nat) (d : Prop) : List (Nat × Prop) → Prop
  | [] => d | (k, P) :: tl => if n = k then P else listLookupProp n d tl

/-- Propositional finite-support subset of `ℕ` (tail-constant above finite override list). -/
structure TailSet : Type where
  /-- Default tail proposition and finite list of pointwise overrides. -/
  tailProp : Prop
  overrides : List (Nat × Prop)

/-- Membership `n ∈ S` for a `TailSet`. -/
@[reducible] def TailSet.mem (n : Nat) (S : TailSet) : Prop :=
  listLookupProp n S.tailProp S.overrides

private def swapNat (i j k : Nat) : Nat := if k = i then j else if k = j then i else k
private theorem swapNat_invol (i j k : Nat) : swapNat i j (swapNat i j k) = k := by
  dsimp only [swapNat]; by_cases h1 : k = i
  · rw [if_pos h1]; by_cases h2 : j = i
    · rw [if_pos h2, h1, h2]
    · rw [if_neg h2, if_pos rfl, h1]
  · rw [if_neg h1]; by_cases h2 : k = j
    · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos rfl, h2]
    · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
private theorem swapNat_inj (i j : Nat) {a b : Nat} (h : swapNat i j a = swapNat i j b) :
    a = b := by
  have h2 := congrArg (swapNat i j) h; rwa [swapNat_invol, swapNat_invol] at h2
private def swapList (i j : Nat) : List (Nat × Prop) → List (Nat × Prop) :=
  List.map (fun p ↦ (swapNat i j p.1, p.2))
private theorem listLookup_swap (i j n : Nat) (d : Prop) (L : List (Nat × Prop)) :
    listLookupProp (swapNat i j n) d (swapList i j L) ↔ listLookupProp n d L := by
  induction L with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons p tl ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨k, P⟩; dsimp only [swapList, List.map, listLookupProp]
    by_cases hnk : n = k
    · subst hnk; rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
    · rw [if_neg (fun heq ↦ hnk (swapNat_inj i j heq)), if_neg hnk]; exact ih
private def listBound : List (Nat × Prop) → Nat
  | [] => 0 | (k, _) :: tl => (k + 1) + listBound tl
private theorem swapList_fix {i j : Nat} (L : List (Nat × Prop))
    (hi : listBound L ≤ i) (hj : listBound L ≤ j) : swapList i j L = L := by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p tl ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨k, P⟩; dsimp only [listBound] at hi hj
    have hki : k ≠ i := Nat.ne_of_lt
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hi))
    have hkj : k ≠ j := Nat.ne_of_lt
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hj))
    have hs : swapNat i j k = k := by dsimp only [swapNat]; rw [if_neg hki, if_neg hkj]
    change (swapNat i j k, P) :: swapList i j tl = (k, P) :: tl
    rw [hs, ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hi) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hj)]
private theorem tailSet_mem_tail (S : TailSet) {n : Nat} (hn : listBound S.overrides ≤ n) :
    TailSet.mem n S ↔ S.tailProp := by
  rcases S with ⟨d, L⟩; change listLookupProp n d L ↔ d
  induction L with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons p tl ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨k, _⟩; dsimp only [listBound] at hn
    have hnk : n ≠ k := Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self k) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hn))
    dsimp only [listLookupProp]; rw [if_neg hnk]; exact ih (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hn)
private def buildOverrides (f : Nat → Prop) : Nat → List (Nat × Prop)
  | 0 => [] | N + 1 => (N, f N) :: buildOverrides f N
private theorem listLookup_build (f : Nat → Prop) (d : Prop) :
    ∀ (N n : Nat), n < N → (listLookupProp n d (buildOverrides f N) ↔ f n)
  | 0, _, h => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ h)
  | N + 1, n, h => by
    dsimp only [buildOverrides, listLookupProp]; by_cases hn : n = N
    · subst hn; rw [if_pos rfl]
    · rw [if_neg hn]; exact listLookup_build f d N n (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h) hn)
private theorem listLookup_build_ge (f : Nat → Prop) (d : Prop) :
    ∀ (N n : Nat), N ≤ n → (listLookupProp n d (buildOverrides f N) ↔ d)
  | 0, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | m + 1, n, h => by
    dsimp only [buildOverrides, listLookupProp]
    rw [if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt h)]; exact listLookup_build_ge f d m n (Nat.le_of_succ_le h)

/-- Carrier for the finitely supported `ℕ` set model `M_fin`. -/
inductive FinTailCarrier : Type
  | atom : Nat → FinTailCarrier | set : TailSet → FinTailCarrier
  | pair : FinTailCarrier → FinTailCarrier → FinTailCarrier
/-- Set base `M_fin` with `atom`, finitely-supported `TailSet`, and inductive `pair`. -/
@[reducible] def finTailBase : SetBase where
  Carrier := FinTailCarrier; pair := FinTailCarrier.pair
  mem x y := match x, y with
    | .atom n, .set S => TailSet.mem n S
    | .atom _, .atom _ => False | .atom _, .pair _ _ => False
    | .set _, .atom _ => False | .set _, .set _ => False | .set _, .pair _ _ => False
    | .pair _ _, .atom _ => False | .pair _ _, .set _ => False | .pair _ _, .pair _ _ => False
  pair_inj h := by injection h with h1 h2; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

private def actCarrier (i j : Nat) : FinTailCarrier → FinTailCarrier
  | .atom n => .atom (swapNat i j n)
  | .set S => .set ⟨S.tailProp, swapList i j S.overrides⟩
  | .pair x y => .pair (actCarrier i j x) (actCarrier i j y)
private theorem actCarrier_invol (i j : Nat) :
    ∀ x : FinTailCarrier, actCarrier i j (actCarrier i j x) = x
  | .atom n => congrArg FinTailCarrier.atom (swapNat_invol i j n)
  | .set S => by
    rcases S with ⟨d, L⟩; dsimp only [actCarrier]; congr 1; congr 1
    induction L with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons p tl ih =>
      rcases p with ⟨k, P⟩
      change (swapNat i j (swapNat i j k), P) :: swapList i j (swapList i j tl) = (k, P) :: tl
      rw [swapNat_invol, ih]
  | .pair x y => by
    dsimp only [actCarrier]; rw [actCarrier_invol i j x, actCarrier_invol i j y]
private theorem actCarrier_mem_iff (i j : Nat) (x y : FinTailCarrier) :
    finTailBase.mem (actCarrier i j x) (actCarrier i j y) ↔ finTailBase.mem x y := by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> first | exact Iff.rfl | exact listLookup_swap i j _ _ _
private def carrierBound : FinTailCarrier → Nat
  | .atom n => n + 1 | .set S => listBound S.overrides
  | .pair x y => carrierBound x + carrierBound y
private theorem actCarrier_fix {i j : Nat} : ∀ x : FinTailCarrier,
    carrierBound x ≤ i → carrierBound x ≤ j → actCarrier i j x = x
  | .atom n, hi, hj => by
    dsimp only [carrierBound] at hi hj; change FinTailCarrier.atom (swapNat i j n) = .atom n
    dsimp only [swapNat]; rw [if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt hi), if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt hj)]
  | .set S, hi, hj => by
    change FinTailCarrier.set ⟨S.tailProp, swapList i j S.overrides⟩ = .set S
    rw [swapList_fix S.overrides hi hj]
  | .pair x y, hi, hj => by
    dsimp only [carrierBound] at hi hj; dsimp only [actCarrier]
    have hx := actCarrier_fix x
      (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hi) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hj)
    have hy := actCarrier_fix y
      (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hi) (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hj)
    rw [hx, hy]

/-- Finite support invariance under all atom permutations fixing an initial segment `[0, N)`. -/
def HasFinSupport (C : Set FinTailCarrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ N : Nat, ∀ i j, N ≤ i → N ≤ j → ∀ x, C (actCarrier i j x) ↔ C x

/-- Concrete `GB0Model` over `finTailBase` whose classes are finitely supported predicates. -/
@[reducible] def finTailModel : GB0Model where
  base := finTailBase; IsClass := HasFinSupport
  ext_mem h hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN
    ⟨N, fun i j hi hj x ↦ (h _).symm.trans ((hN i j hi hj x).trans (h _))⟩
  singleton_mem p := ⟨carrierBound p, fun i j hi hj x ↦ by
    have hp := actCarrier_fix p hi hj
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j x, h, hp], fun h ↦ by rw [h, hp]⟩⟩
  set_mem p := ⟨carrierBound p, fun i j hi hj x ↦ by
    have hm := actCarrier_mem_iff i j x p; rw [actCarrier_fix p hi hj] at hm; exact hm⟩
  g1_memRel := ⟨0, fun i j _ _ z ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
      by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j z, hz]; rfl, (actCarrier_mem_iff i j x y).mpr h⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
       by rw [hz]; rfl, (actCarrier_mem_iff i j x y).mpr h⟩⟩⟩
  g2_inter h₁ h₂ := let ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := h₁; let ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := h₂; ⟨N₁ + N₂, fun i j hi hj x ↦
    and_congr (h₁ i j (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hi)
        (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) hj) x)
      (h₂ i j (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hi)
        (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) hj) x)⟩
  g3_compl hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj x ↦ not_congr (hN i j hi hj x)⟩
  g4_dom hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj x ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j y,
       (hN i j hi hj (.pair x (actCarrier i j y))).mp
         (by dsimp only [actCarrier]; rw [actCarrier_invol]; exact hy)⟩,
     fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j y, (hN i j hi hj (.pair x y)).mpr hy⟩⟩⟩
  g5_prodV hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj z ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hz, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
      by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j z, hz]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj x).mpr hx⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, hz, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
       by rw [hz]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj x).mpr hx⟩⟩⟩
  g6_converse hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj z ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
      by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j z, hz]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair y x)).mpr h⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y,
       by rw [hz]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair y x)).mpr h⟩⟩⟩
  g7_cycleRight hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj w ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y, actCarrier i j z,
      by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j w, hw]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair y (.pair z x))).mpr hc⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y, actCarrier i j z,
       by rw [hw]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair y (.pair z x))).mpr hc⟩⟩⟩
  g8_swapInner hN := let ⟨N, hN⟩ := hN; ⟨N, fun i j hi hj w ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y, actCarrier i j z,
      by rw [← actCarrier_invol i j w, hw]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair x (.pair z y))).mpr hc⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨actCarrier i j x, actCarrier i j y, actCarrier i j z,
       by rw [hw]; rfl, (hN i j hi hj (.pair x (.pair z y))).mpr hc⟩⟩⟩
  subclass_sep C hN hB := by
    rcases hN with ⟨N, hN⟩; rcases hB with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨.set ⟨C (.atom N), buildOverrides (fun k ↦ C (.atom k)) N⟩, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    cases x with
    | atom n =>
      by_cases hn : n < N
      · exact listLookup_build (fun k ↦ C (.atom k)) (C (.atom N)) N n hn
      · have hNle : N ≤ n := Nat.le_of_not_lt hn
        have hTail : TailSet.mem n ⟨C (.atom N), buildOverrides (fun k ↦ C (.atom k)) N⟩ ↔
            C (.atom N) :=
          listLookup_build_ge (fun k ↦ C (.atom k)) (C (.atom N)) N n hNle
        have hSwap := hN N n (Nat.le_refl N) hNle (.atom N)
        have hEq : actCarrier N n (.atom N) = .atom n := by
          change FinTailCarrier.atom (swapNat N n N) = .atom n
          dsimp only [swapNat]; rw [if_pos rfl]
        rw [hEq] at hSwap; exact hTail.trans hSwap.symm
    | set _ | pair _ _ =>
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ False.elim h, fun h ↦ by have hm := ha _ h; cases a <;> cases hm⟩

/-- Carrier for `M_full`, adjoining arbitrary `Set Nat` subsets alongside `TailSet`. -/
inductive FullNatCarrier : Type
  | atom : Nat → FullNatCarrier | set : (TailSet ⊕ Set Nat) → FullNatCarrier
  | pair : FullNatCarrier → FullNatCarrier → FullNatCarrier
/-- Set base `M_full` containing every subset of `ℕ`. -/
@[reducible] def fullNatBase : SetBase where
  Carrier := FullNatCarrier; pair := FullNatCarrier.pair
  mem x y := match x, y with
    | .atom n, .set (.inl S) => TailSet.mem n S | .atom n, .set (.inr A) => A n
    | .atom _, .atom _ => False | .atom _, .pair _ _ => False
    | .set _, .atom _ => False | .set _, .set _ => False | .set _, .pair _ _ => False
    | .pair _ _, .atom _ => False | .pair _ _, .set _ => False | .pair _ _, .pair _ _ => False
  pair_inj h := by injection h with h1 h2; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
/-- Full second-order `GB0Model` over `fullNatBase`. -/
@[reducible] def fullNatModel : GB0Model where
  base := fullNatBase; IsClass _ := True
  ext_mem _ _ := trivial; singleton_mem _ := trivial; set_mem _ := trivial
  g1_memRel := trivial; g2_inter _ _ := trivial; g3_compl _ := trivial
  g4_dom _ := trivial; g5_prodV _ := trivial; g6_converse _ := trivial
  g7_cycleRight _ := trivial; g8_swapInner _ := trivial
  subclass_sep C _ hB := by
    rcases hB with ⟨a, ha⟩; refine ⟨.set (.inr fun n ↦ C (.atom n)), fun x ↦ ?_⟩
    cases x with
    | atom _ => exact Iff.rfl
    | set _ | pair _ _ =>
      exact ⟨fun h ↦ False.elim h, fun h ↦ by have hm := ha _ h; cases a <;> cases hm⟩

/-- Canonical embedding `f : M_fin ↪ M_full`. -/
def finToFull : FinTailCarrier → FullNatCarrier
  | .atom n => .atom n | .set S => .set (.inl S)
  | .pair x y => .pair (finToFull x) (finToFull y)
/-- Injectivity of `finToFull` (axiom-free). -/
theorem finToFull_injective : Function.Injective finToFull := by
  intro x y h; induction x generalizing y with
  | atom m => cases y with | atom n => injection h with e; subst e; rfl | _ => cases h
  | set S => cases y with | set T => injection h with e; cases e; rfl | _ => cases h
  | pair _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => cases y with
    | pair _ _ => injection h with h1 h2; rw [ih₁ h1, ih₂ h2]
    | _ => cases h
/-- Membership preservation and reflection along `finToFull`. -/
theorem finToFull_mem_iff (x y : FinTailCarrier) :
    finTailBase.mem x y ↔ fullNatBase.mem (finToFull x) (finToFull y) := by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> exact Iff.rfl
/-- Pair preservation along `finToFull`. -/
theorem finToFull_pair_map (x y : FinTailCarrier) :
    finToFull (finTailBase.pair x y) = fullNatBase.pair (finToFull x) (finToFull y) := rfl
/-- Pointwise trace preimage `f⁻¹[D]`. -/
def preimageClass {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (D : Set B) : Set A := fun x ↦ D (f x)
/-- Naive trace pullback collection `f^*𝒟 = {C | ∃ D ∈ 𝒟, C ≡ f⁻¹[D]}`. -/
def naiveTracePullback {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (IsD : Set B → Prop) (C : Set A) : Prop :=
  ∃ D : Set B, IsD D ∧ ∀ x, C x ↔ D (f x)
/-- Even natural numbers `{n ∈ ℕ | ∃ k, n = 2 * k}`. -/
def evenNat : Set Nat := fun n ↦ ∃ k : Nat, n = 2 * k
/-- Definable class of even naturals inside `Def(M_full)`. -/
def evenFullClass : Set FullNatCarrier := evalGodelExpr fullNatBase (.setElts (.set (.inr evenNat)))
/-- The infinite set `ω` inside `M_fin`. -/
def omegaFinSet : FinTailCarrier := .set ⟨True, []⟩
/-- External set witness `y₀ = evenNat ∈ M_full \ range(finToFull)`. -/
def externalWitness : FullNatCarrier := .set (.inr evenNat)
/-- Concrete G4 counterexample class `D = {(f(x₀), y₀)} ∈ Def(M_full)`. -/
def g4PairClass : Set FullNatCarrier :=
  evalGodelExpr fullNatBase (.singleton (fullNatBase.pair (finToFull (.atom 0)) externalWitness))
/-- Empty definable class `D₁ = ∅ ∈ Def(M_full)`. -/
def emptyFullClass : Set FullNatCarrier :=
  evalGodelExpr fullNatBase (.setElts (.set (.inr fun _ ↦ False)))
/-- Singleton definable class `D₂ = {y₀} ∈ Def(M_full)`. -/
def extWitnessClass : Set FullNatCarrier := evalGodelExpr fullNatBase (.singleton externalWitness)

private theorem nat_two_mul_le (N : Nat) : N ≤ 2 * N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | succ k ih => exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.succ_le_succ ih) (Nat.le_succ _)
private theorem two_mul_succ_ne_two_mul : ∀ a b : Nat, 2 * a + 1 ≠ 2 * b
  | 0, 0, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | 0, b + 1, h => by change 1 = 2 * b + 2 at h; exact Nat.noConfusion (Nat.succ.inj h)
  | _ + 1, 0, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => by
    change 2 * a + 3 = 2 * b + 2 at h
    exact two_mul_succ_ne_two_mul a b (Nat.succ.inj (Nat.succ.inj h))

/-- Obstruction (1): `f⁻¹[evenFullClass]` is bounded by `ω` yet has no set in `M_fin`. -/
theorem pullback_breaks_subclass_sep :
    fullNatModel.IsClass evenFullClass ∧
    (∀ x, preimageClass finToFull evenFullClass x → finTailBase.mem x omegaFinSet) ∧
    (¬ ∃ b : FinTailCarrier,
      ∀ x, finTailBase.mem x b ↔ preimageClass finToFull evenFullClass x) ∧
    ¬ SatisfiesSubclassSep finTailBase (naiveTracePullback finToFull fullNatModel.IsClass) := by
  have hBound : ∀ x, preimageClass finToFull evenFullClass x →
      finTailBase.mem x omegaFinSet := by
    intro x hx; cases x with | atom _ => trivial | _ => exact False.elim hx
  have hNoSet : ¬ ∃ b : FinTailCarrier,
      ∀ x, finTailBase.mem x b ↔ preimageClass finToFull evenFullClass x := by
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩; cases b with
    | atom _ | pair _ _ => exact (hb (.atom 0)).mpr ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | set S =>
      let N := listBound S.overrides
      have hE : S.tailProp := (tailSet_mem_tail S (nat_two_mul_le N)).mp
        ((hb (.atom (2 * N))).mpr ⟨N, rfl⟩)
      have hO : evenNat (2 * N + 1) := (hb (.atom (2 * N + 1))).mp
        ((tailSet_mem_tail S (Nat.le_succ_of_le (nat_two_mul_le N))).mpr hE)
      rcases hO with ⟨k, hk⟩; exact two_mul_succ_ne_two_mul N k hk
  refine ⟨trivial, hBound, hNoSet, fun hSep ↦ hNoSet ?_⟩
  exact hSep _ ⟨evenFullClass, trivial, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩ ⟨omegaFinSet, hBound⟩

/-- Obstruction (2): `dom^{M_fin}(f⁻¹[D]) = ∅ ≠ {x₀} = f⁻¹[dom^{M_full}(D)]`. -/
theorem pullback_breaks_g4_dom :
    (∀ x, ¬ domClass finTailBase (preimageClass finToFull g4PairClass) x) ∧
    preimageClass finToFull (domClass fullNatBase g4PairClass) (.atom 0) := by
  refine ⟨fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ?_, ⟨externalWitness, rfl⟩⟩
  change finToFull (finTailBase.pair x y) =
    fullNatBase.pair (finToFull (.atom 0)) externalWitness at hy
  rw [finToFull_pair_map] at hy; cases y <;> cases (fullNatBase.pair_inj hy).2

/-- Obstruction (3): `f⁻¹[D₁] = ∅ = f⁻¹[D₂]` collapses distinct classes `∅ ≠ {y₀}`. -/
theorem pullback_collapses_distinct_classes :
    (extWitnessClass externalWitness ∧ ¬ emptyFullClass externalWitness) ∧
    (∀ x, preimageClass finToFull emptyFullClass x ↔ preimageClass finToFull extWitnessClass x) :=
  ⟨⟨rfl, fun h ↦ h⟩, fun x ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ False.elim (by cases x <;> exact h), fun h ↦ by

nodes.title: Minimal Definability Adjunction Def -| pi_Set and Coreflective Fiber Initiality

dual_pillars.purpose: Axiom-free Emerald Lean 4 proof of Def -| pi_Set, full faithfulness, and fiber initiality

nodes.statement: Over set universes M equipped with first-order definable Subclass Separation (DefAlgebra), minimal Godel-expression expansion Def(M) forms a functor Def : DefAlgebra -> GB0Model left adjoint to pi_Set (Def -| pi_Set) via a natural hom-bijection Hom_{GB0}(Def(M), Y) ~= Hom_Set(M, pi_Set(Y)) with identity unit eta_M : M ~= pi_Set(Def(M)) and vertical inclusion counit eps_{(M,C)} : Def(M) >-> (M, C). In particular, Def embeds DefAlgebra as a full coreflective subcategory of Mod(GB_0) with coreflector pi_Set, and Def(M) is initial in every vertical fiber pi_Set^{-1}(M).
nodes.tex:
\begin{theorem}[Minimal Definability Adjunction {{sym:def-functor}} $\dashv$ {{sym:piset}} and Coreflective Fiber Initiality]\label{ch02:thm:def-left-adjoint-coreflection}%
\uses{ch02:def:gb0-model-category,ch02:thm:three-way-pullback-failure}%
Let $\mathbf{DefAlg}$ denote the category of set universes $M$ satisfying first-order G\"odel Subclass Separation (models of $\mathsf{Z}$) with $\mathcal{L}_\in$-elementary embeddings~\cite{godel1940}. Although {{sym:piset}} fails to be a Grothendieck fibration by Theorem~\ref{ch02:thm:three-way-pullback-failure}, minimal parameter-definable expansion defines a functor ${{sym:def-functor}} : \mathbf{DefAlg} \to {{sym:mod-gb0}}$ left adjoint to {{sym:piset}}:
\[
  {{sym:def-functor}} \;\dashv\; {{sym:piset}} : {{sym:mod-gb0}} \longrightarrow \mathbf{DefAlg}.
\]
Specifically:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item The natural hom-bijection $\mathrm{Hom}_{{{sym:mod-gb0}}}({{sym:def-functor}}(M), (N, \mathcal{D})) \cong \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{DefAlg}}(M, {{sym:piset}}(N, \mathcal{D}))$ transports each G\"odel expression $\llbracket e \rrbracket_M \in {{sym:def-functor}}(M)$ along $f : M \hookrightarrow N$ to $\llbracket f(e) \rrbracket_N \in {{sym:def-functor}}(N) \subseteq \mathcal{D}$.
  \item The unit $\eta_M : M \xrightarrow{\sim} {{sym:piset}}({{sym:def-functor}}(M))$ is the identity, while the counit $\varepsilon_{(M, \mathcal{C})} : {{sym:def-functor}}(M) \hookrightarrow (M, \mathcal{C})$ is the vertical inclusion of definable classes into $\mathcal{C}$.
  \item Consequently, ${{sym:def-functor}}$ embeds $\mathbf{DefAlg}$ as a \textbf{full coreflective subcategory} of ${{sym:mod-gb0}}$ with coreflector {{sym:piset}}~\cite{maclane1998}, and ${{sym:def-functor}}(M)$ is the unique initial object inside every vertical fiber ${{sym:piset}}^{-1}(M)$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Constructively without choice, define the transported class $F_f(S) := \{y \in N \mid \exists e,\; (S \equiv \llbracket e \rrbracket_M) \wedge y \in \llbracket f(e) \rrbracket_N\}$; extensional equivalence of expressions under $\mathcal{L}_\in$-elementarity of $f$ places $F_f(S)$ inside $\mathcal{D}$ and forces uniqueness of any two-sorted morphism out of ${{sym:def-functor}}(M)$ agreeing with $f$ on the set base. Full faithfulness follows because $\eta_M = \mathrm{id}_M$ is an isomorphism; setting $f = \mathrm{id}_M$ yields the vertical counit inclusion $\varepsilon_{(M,\mathcal{C})}$ and uniqueness of the vertical morphism ${{sym:def-functor}}(M) \to (M,\mathcal{C})$ over $\mathrm{id}_M$.
\end{proof}
nodes.lean_signature:
/-- Predicate characterizing minimal parameter-definable Gödel classes `Def(M)`. -/
@[reducible] def DefIsClass (M : SetBase) (S : Set M.Carrier) : Prop :=
  ∃ e : GodelExpr M.Carrier, ∀ x, S x ↔ evalGodelExpr M e x

/-- Set base satisfying first-order Subclass Separation for Gödel-definable classes. -/
structure DefAlgebra : Type 1 extends SetBase where
  /-- First-order Separation schema over `Def(M)`. -/
  def_sep : SatisfiesSubclassSep toSetBase (DefIsClass toSetBase)

/-- Coreflector extraction `DefAlgebra` underlying any `GB0Model`. -/
@[reducible] def piSetDef (X : GB0Model) : DefAlgebra where
  toSetBase := X.base
  def_sep C hC hB := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC
    X.subclass_sep C (X.ext_mem (fun x ↦ (he x).symm) (evalGodelExpr_isClass X e)) hB

/-- Minimal Gödel class expansion `Def(M) ∈ Mod(GB₀)`. -/
@[reducible] def defModel (M : DefAlgebra) : GB0Model where
  base := M.toSetBase; IsClass := DefIsClass M.toSetBase
  ext_mem h hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨e, fun x ↦ (h x).symm.trans (he x)⟩
  singleton_mem p := ⟨.singleton p, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩
  set_mem p := ⟨.setElts p, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩
  g1_memRel := ⟨.memRel, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩
  g2_inter h₁ h₂ := let ⟨e₁, f₁⟩ := h₁; let ⟨e₂, f₂⟩ := h₂
    ⟨.inter e₁ e₂, fun x ↦ and_congr (f₁ x) (f₂ x)⟩
  g3_compl hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨.compl e, fun x ↦ not_congr (he x)⟩
  g4_dom hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC
    ⟨.dom e, fun _ ↦ ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨y, (he _).mp hy⟩, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨y, (he _).mpr hy⟩⟩⟩
  g5_prodV hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨.prodV e, fun _ ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hz, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, hz, (he x).mp hx⟩, fun ⟨x, y, hz, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, hz, (he x).mpr hx⟩⟩⟩
  g6_converse hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨.converse e, fun _ ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, hz, (he _).mp h⟩, fun ⟨x, y, hz, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, hz, (he _).mpr h⟩⟩⟩
  g7_cycleRight hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨.cycleRight e, fun _ ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, z, hw, (he _).mp h⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, z, hw, (he _).mpr h⟩⟩⟩
  g8_swapInner hC := let ⟨e, he⟩ := hC; ⟨.swapInner e, fun _ ↦
    ⟨fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, z, hw, (he _).mp h⟩,
     fun ⟨x, y, z, hw, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, y, z, hw, (he _).mpr h⟩⟩⟩
  subclass_sep := M.def_sep

/-- Axiom-free class transport `⟦e⟧_M ↦ ⟦f(e)⟧_N` without `Classical.choose`. -/
def transportDefClass {M : SetBase} {Y : GB0Model} (f : SetBaseHom M Y.base)
    (S : Set M.Carrier) : Set Y.base.Carrier :=
  fun y ↦ ∃ e : GodelExpr M.Carrier,
    (∀ x, S x ↔ evalGodelExpr M e x) ∧ evalGodelExpr Y.base (e.map f.toFun) y

/-- Transported definable class lies in `Y.IsClass` (axiom-free). -/
theorem transportDefClass_isClass {M : SetBase} {Y : GB0Model} (f : SetBaseHom M Y.base)
    {S : Set M.Carrier} (hS : DefIsClass M S) : Y.IsClass (transportDefClass f S) := by
  rcases hS with ⟨e₀, he₀⟩
  exact Y.ext_mem (fun y ↦ Iff.intro (fun hy ↦ ⟨e₀, he₀, hy⟩)
    (fun ⟨e, he, hy⟩ ↦ (f.elem_ext e e₀ (fun x ↦ (he x).symm.trans (he₀ x)) y).mp hy))
    (evalGodelExpr_isClass Y (e₀.map f.toFun))

/-- Canonical adjunction transpose `liftFromDef f : Def(M) → Y` of `f : M → π_Set(Y)`. -/
def liftFromDef {M : DefAlgebra} {Y : GB0Model} (f : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase (piSet Y)) :
    GB0Hom (defModel M) Y where
  baseHom := f
  classMap C := ⟨transportDefClass f C.1, transportDefClass_isClass f C.2⟩
  classMap_ext C₁ C₂ hEq y :=
    ⟨fun ⟨e, he, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨e, fun x ↦ (hEq x).symm.trans (he x), hy⟩,
     fun ⟨e, he, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨e, fun x ↦ (hEq x).trans (he x), hy⟩⟩
  mem_preserve C x := by
    rcases C.2 with ⟨e, he⟩
    refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ⟨e, he, (f.elem_iff e x).mp ((he x).mp hx)⟩, fun ⟨e', he', hy⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    exact (he x).mpr ((f.elem_iff e x).mpr
      ((f.elem_ext e' e (fun z ↦ (he' z).symm.trans (he z)) (f.toFun x)).mp hy))
  map_godel e y :=
    ⟨fun ⟨e', he', hy⟩ ↦ (f.elem_ext e' e (fun x ↦ (he' x).symm) y).mp hy,
     fun hy ↦ ⟨e, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl, hy⟩⟩

/-- Uniqueness of `liftFromDef φ.baseHom` up to `GB0Hom.Eq`. -/
theorem liftFromDef_unique {M : DefAlgebra} {Y : GB0Model} (φ : GB0Hom (defModel M) Y) :
    GB0Hom.Eq (liftFromDef (piSetMap φ)) φ := by
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun C y ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases C.2 with ⟨e, he⟩
  have h1 := (liftFromDef (piSetMap φ)).classMap_ext C ⟨_, ⟨e, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩⟩ he y
  have h2 := φ.classMap_ext C ⟨_, ⟨e, fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl⟩⟩ he y
  have h3 := (liftFromDef (piSetMap φ)).map_godel e y
  exact h1.trans (h3.trans ((φ.map_godel e y).symm.trans h2.symm))

/-- Action of `Def` on `SetBaseHom` morphisms. -/
def defMap {M N : DefAlgebra} (f : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase N.toSetBase) :
    GB0Hom (defModel M) (defModel N) := liftFromDef f
/-- Functorial identity law for `Def`. -/
theorem defMap_id (M : DefAlgebra) :
    GB0Hom.Eq (defMap (SetBaseHom.id M.toSetBase)) (GB0Hom.id (defModel M)) :=
  liftFromDef_unique (GB0Hom.id (defModel M))
/-- Functorial composition law for `Def`. -/
theorem defMap_comp {L M N : DefAlgebra} (f : SetBaseHom L.toSetBase M.toSetBase)
    (g : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase N.toSetBase) :
    GB0Hom.Eq (defMap (SetBaseHom.comp f g)) (GB0Hom.comp (defMap f) (defMap g)) :=
  liftFromDef_unique (GB0Hom.comp (defMap f) (defMap g))
/-- Identity unit `η_M : M → π_Set(Def(M))`. -/
def defUnit (M : DefAlgebra) : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase (piSet (defModel M)) :=
  SetBaseHom.id M.toSetBase
/-- Vertical inclusion counit `ε_X : Def(π_Set(X)) → X`. -/
def defCounit (X : GB0Model) : GB0Hom (defModel (piSetDef X)) X :=
  liftFromDef (SetBaseHom.id X.base)
/-- Counit `ε_X` acts vertically as class inclusion `Def(M) ↪ C`. -/
theorem defCounit_vertical_inclusion (X : GB0Model)
    (C : {S : Set X.base.Carrier // (defModel (piSetDef X)).IsClass S}) (y : X.base.Carrier) :
    ((defCounit X).classMap C).1 y ↔ C.1 y := by
  rcases C.2 with ⟨e, he⟩
  refine ⟨fun ⟨e', he', hy⟩ ↦ ?_, fun hy ↦ ⟨e, he, ?_⟩⟩
  · change evalGodelExpr X.base (e'.map _root_.id) y at hy
    rw [GodelExpr.map_id] at hy; exact (he' y).mpr hy
  · change evalGodelExpr X.base (e.map _root_.id) y
    rw [GodelExpr.map_id]; exact (he y).mp hy

/-- **Minimal Definability Adjunction `Def ⊣ π_Set` (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    Establishes the natural hom-bijection, triangle identities, identity unit, vertical
    inclusion counit, full faithfulness of `Def` as a coreflective subcategory embedding,
    and initiality of `Def(M)` inside every vertical fiber `π_Set⁻¹(M)`. -/
theorem def_left_adjoint_coreflection :
    (∀ {M : DefAlgebra} {Y : GB0Model} (φ : GB0Hom (defModel M) Y),
      GB0Hom.Eq (liftFromDef (piSetMap φ)) φ) ∧
    (∀ {M : DefAlgebra} {Y : GB0Model} (f : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase (piSet Y)),
      SetBaseHom.Eq (piSetMap (liftFromDef f)) f) ∧
    (∀ {M N : DefAlgebra} {Y : GB0Model} (h : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase N.toSetBase)
      (f : SetBaseHom N.toSetBase (piSet Y)),
      GB0Hom.Eq (liftFromDef (SetBaseHom.comp h f))
        (GB0Hom.comp (defMap h) (liftFromDef f))) ∧
    (∀ {M : DefAlgebra} {Y Z : GB0Model} (g : GB0Hom Y Z) (φ : GB0Hom (defModel M) Y),
      SetBaseHom.Eq (piSetMap (GB0Hom.comp φ g))
        (SetBaseHom.comp (piSetMap φ) (piSetMap g))) ∧
    (∀ (M : DefAlgebra),
      GB0Hom.Eq (GB0Hom.comp (defMap (defUnit M)) (defCounit (defModel M)))
        (GB0Hom.id (defModel M))) ∧
    (∀ (X : GB0Model),
      SetBaseHom.Eq (SetBaseHom.comp (defUnit (piSetDef X)) (piSetMap (defCounit X)))
        (SetBaseHom.id (piSet X))) ∧
    (∀ (M : DefAlgebra), piSet (defModel M) = M.toSetBase) ∧
    (∀ (X : GB0Model) (C : {S // (defModel (piSetDef X)).IsClass S})
      (y : X.base.Carrier), ((defCounit X).classMap C).1 y ↔ C.1 y) ∧
    (∀ {M N : DefAlgebra} (f g : SetBaseHom M.toSetBase N.toSetBase),
      GB0Hom.Eq (defMap f) (defMap g) → SetBaseHom.Eq f g) ∧
    (∀ {M N : DefAlgebra} (φ : GB0Hom (defModel M) (defModel N)),
      GB0Hom.Eq (defMap (piSetMap φ)) φ) ∧
    (∀ (X : GB0Model) (ψ : GB0Hom (defModel (piSetDef X)) X),
      SetBaseHom.Eq ψ.baseHom (SetBaseHom.id X.base) → GB0Hom.Eq ψ (defCounit X)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

  · intro M N Y h f; exact liftFromDef_unique (GB0Hom.comp (defMap h) (liftFromDef f))
  · intro M; refine ⟨fun _ ↦ rfl, fun C y ↦ ?_⟩
    exact (defCounit_vertical_inclusion (defModel M) ((defMap (defUnit M)).classMap C) y).trans
      ((defMap_id M).2 C y)
  · have hU := liftFromDef_unique ψ
    refine ⟨fun x ↦ hBase x, fun C y ↦ (hU.2 C y).symm.trans ?_⟩
    refine ⟨fun ⟨e, he, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨e, he, ?_⟩, fun ⟨e, he, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨e, he, ?_⟩⟩

nodes.title: Syntactic Pullback Square for Conservative Class Extensions vs. Breakdown

dual_pillars.purpose: Axiom-free Emerald Lean 4 proof of conservative syntactic pullback square vs. non-conservativity breakdown

nodes.statement: In contrast to semantic model-space pullback failure (Theorem ch02:thm:three-way-pullback-failure), inside the syntactic interpretability preorder of two-sorted class theories (T_set, T_cls) equipped with the adjunction Def_syn -| Tr_set (where Tr_set extracts first-order L_in-set theorems), whenever T_0 <= T_1, E_0 is L_in-conservative over T_0 (Tr_set(E_0) == T_0), and E_1 == Def_syn(T_1) sup E_0, the pushout square forms a genuine pullback square against minimal class extensions Def_syn(X) and on set traces. Conversely, any non-conservative set leak X <= Tr_set(L_0) with X <= T_1 and not (X <= T_0) destroys the pullback square (previewing Chapter 3 when Replacement or Foundation is dropped).

/-- Interpretability / deductive-inclusion preorder with finite deductive joins `T₁ ∪ T₂`. -/
structure TheoryJoinPreorder : Type 1 where
  /-- Carrier type of syntactic theories. -/
  T : Type
  /-- Deductive inclusion `T₁ ≤ T₂`. -/
  le : T → T → Prop
  /-- Reflexivity of deduction. -/
  le_refl : ∀ a, le a a
  /-- Transitivity of deduction. -/
  le_trans : ∀ {a b c}, le a b → le b c → le a c
  /-- Deductive join / theory union `a ⊔ b`. -/
  sup : T → T → T
  /-- Left inclusion into deductive join. -/
  le_sup_left : ∀ a b, le a (sup a b)
  /-- Right inclusion into deductive join. -/
  le_sup_right : ∀ a b, le b (sup a b)
  /-- Universal property of deductive join. -/
  sup_le : ∀ {a b c}, le a c → le b c → le (sup a b) c

/-- Mutual deductive interpretability equivalence `a ≡ b`. -/
def TheoryJoinPreorder.Equiv (P : TheoryJoinPreorder) (a b : P.T) : Prop := P.le a b ∧ P.le b a

/-- Two-sorted syntactic theory lattice with `Def_syn ⊣ Tr_set` Galois adjunction. -/
structure SyntacticClassSystem : Type 1 where
  /-- Lattice of first-order set theories. -/
  SetTh : TheoryJoinPreorder
  /-- Lattice of two-sorted class theories. -/
  ClsTh : TheoryJoinPreorder
  /-- Minimal conservative class expansion `Def_syn : SetTh → ClsTh`. -/
  defSyn : SetTh.T → ClsTh.T
  /-- First-order `L_∈`-theorem trace `Tr_set : ClsTh → SetTh`. -/
  traceSet : ClsTh.T → SetTh.T
  /-- Monotonicity of `Def_syn`. -/
  defSyn_mono : ∀ {a b}, SetTh.le a b → ClsTh.le (defSyn a) (defSyn b)
  /-- Monotonicity of `Tr_set`. -/
  traceSet_mono : ∀ {a b}, ClsTh.le a b → SetTh.le (traceSet a) (traceSet b)
  /-- Syntactic adjunction `Def_syn(T) ≤ S ↔ T ≤ Tr_set(S)`. -/
  defSyn_le_iff : ∀ T S, ClsTh.le (defSyn T) S ↔ SetTh.le T (traceSet S)
  /-- `L_∈`-conservativity of minimal expansion `Tr_set(Def_syn(T)) ≤ T`. -/
  defSyn_cons : ∀ T : SetTh.T, SetTh.le (traceSet (defSyn T)) T

/-- `L_∈`-conservativity of class extension `S` over set theory `T`: `Tr_set(S) ≡ T`. -/
def IsConservativeExt (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem) (S : Sys.ClsTh.T) (T : Sys.SetTh.T) : Prop :=
  Sys.SetTh.Equiv (Sys.traceSet S) T

/-- **Syntactic Conservative Pullback Theorem (Emerald, Axiom-Free):**
    In `SyntacticClassSystem`, any `L_∈`-conservative extension `E₀` over `T₀ ≤ T₁` generates an
    opcartesian join `E₁ ≡ Def_syn(T₁) ⊔ E₀` forming a genuine pullback square against minimal
    extensions `Def_syn(X)` and set traces; conversely, any set-level leak destroys the pullback. -/
theorem syntactic_conservative_pullback (Sys : SyntacticClassSystem)
    (T₀ T₁ : Sys.SetTh.T) (E₀ E₁ : Sys.ClsTh.T)
    (hT : Sys.SetTh.le T₀ T₁) (hCons : IsConservativeExt Sys E₀ T₀)
    (hPush : Sys.ClsTh.Equiv E₁ (Sys.ClsTh.sup (Sys.defSyn T₁) E₀)) :
    (Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn T₁) E₁ ∧ Sys.ClsTh.le E₀ E₁ ∧
      ∀ Z, Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn T₁) Z → Sys.ClsTh.le E₀ Z → Sys.ClsTh.le E₁ Z) ∧
    (∀ X : Sys.SetTh.T,
      (Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) E₀ ∧ Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₁)) ↔
        Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₀)) ∧
    (∀ X : Sys.SetTh.T,
      (Sys.SetTh.le X (Sys.traceSet E₀) ∧ Sys.SetTh.le X T₁) ↔ Sys.SetTh.le X T₀) ∧
    (∀ (L₀ : Sys.ClsTh.T) (X : Sys.SetTh.T),
      Sys.SetTh.le X (Sys.traceSet L₀) → Sys.SetTh.le X T₁ → ¬ Sys.SetTh.le X T₀ →
      Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) L₀ ∧ Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₁) ∧
        ¬ Sys.ClsTh.le (Sys.defSyn X) (Sys.defSyn T₀)) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}
